name: SSHI_FBR_Zener
rationale: The Reference Design (FBR) fails S2 and S4 because the open-circuit voltage (Voc) is too low to overcome the diode drops of the bridge (especially in S4 where Voc ~ 1.9V, leading to Vout ~ 1.4V). Additionally, S3 exceeds Vmax. I am introducing a Synchronous Switching Harvesting on Inductor (SSHI) stage using an inductor and a switch to invert the piezo voltage at its peaks, effectively boosting the voltage delivered to the rectifier. A Zener diode (DZ33) is added to clamp the output at 3.3V for S3, and a large storage capacitor is used to minimize ripple and stabilize the output.
